item.title: Despite widespread criticism, Senate okays Omokri, Mahmud, 62 others as ambassadors
item.description: THE Senate has confirmed the appointment of 64 ambassadorial nominees, despite sustained criticism from opposition parties and many Nigerians over their nomination. Of the confirmed nominees, 34 are career ambassadors, while 30 are non-career.
